inputs.name: shape
inputs.constraints: Any fixture-supported shape, including rank-0 scalars and higher-rank tensors.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Any dtype supported by the Array API fixture surface.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Array of the requested shape and dtype filled with additive identity 0.

tolerance_policy.notes: Zero construction is deterministic; values, shape, and dtype must match exactly.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Return zeros for every element in the requested output shape using the requested dtype.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; malformed shapes or unsupported dtypes fail before allocation.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.constraints: Any fixture-supported shape.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Any dtype supported by the Array API fixture surface.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Array of the requested shape and dtype filled with multiplicative identity 1.

tolerance_policy.notes: One construction is deterministic; values, shape, and dtype must match exactly.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Return ones for every element in the requested output shape using the requested dtype.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; malformed shapes or unsupported dtypes fail before allocation.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.constraints: Any fixture-supported shape.

inputs.name: fill_value
inputs.constraints: Scalar value broadcast into every element.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Target dtype for the constructed array.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Array filled with the provided scalar value after dtype conversion.

tolerance_policy.notes: Fill construction is deterministic for the fixture surface, including complex128 payloads.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Broadcast the fill value to the requested shape and cast into the requested dtype.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject malformed scalar encodings before construction.

inputs.name: start
inputs.constraints: Inclusive lower bound for range generation.

inputs.name: stop
inputs.constraints: Exclusive upper bound for range generation.

inputs.name: step
inputs.constraints: Non-zero step value with sign consistent with the desired traversal.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Optional dtype override for the result.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Half-open numeric sequence produced by repeated stepping from start toward stop.

tolerance_policy.notes: Floating-point stepping may accumulate endpoint drift; near-equal values should still match.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Emit the half-open range defined by start, stop, and step, mirroring the Array API fixture semantics.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject zero steps and impossible traversals before sequence generation.

inputs.name: start
inputs.constraints: Lower endpoint of the interpolation interval.

inputs.name: stop
inputs.constraints: Upper endpoint of the interpolation interval.

inputs.name: num
inputs.constraints: Number of samples to emit.

inputs.name: endpoint
inputs.constraints: Whether the stop value is included in the output.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Optional dtype override for the result.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Evenly spaced samples spanning the requested interval.

tolerance_policy.notes: Floating-point interpolation of evenly spaced samples may differ by rounding at the final ulps.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Emit evenly spaced samples across the interval, respecting the endpoint flag and requested dtype.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject zero-length and malformed requests before interpolation.

inputs.name: shapes
inputs.constraints: Two or more shapes participating in an Array API broadcast computation.

tolerance_policy.notes: Broadcasted shape resolution is categorical; no numeric tolerance applies.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Return the broadcast-compatible output shape for the provided inputs.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject impossible broadcast combinations with an error before shape synthesis.

inputs.name: dtypes
inputs.constraints: At least one dtype from the fixture-supported set.

outputs.name: dtype
outputs.semantics: Promoted result dtype for the provided dtype set.

tolerance_policy.notes: Type promotion is categorical; no numeric tolerance applies.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Return the Array API result-type promotion for the provided dtypes.

inputs.name: values
inputs.constraints: Flat source values compatible with the requested shape.

inputs.name: shape
inputs.constraints: Requested output shape whose element count matches the source values.

inputs.name: dtype
inputs.constraints: Target dtype for the constructed array.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Array with the requested shape, dtype, and source values preserved in row-major order.

tolerance_policy.notes: Asarray conversion in the fixture surface is deterministic and should match exactly.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Construct an array from the provided scalar payload, preserving row-major ordering.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject length/shape mismatches before allocation.

inputs.name: source
inputs.constraints: Source array built from fixture values and shape metadata.

inputs.name: index
inputs.constraints: Basic or advanced indexing expression within the bounds of the source array.

outputs.name: result
outputs.semantics: Indexed view/materialization produced by the requested getitem operation.

tolerance_policy.notes: Indexed values and ordering should match exactly for the fixture surface.

contracts.strict_mode_behavior: Apply the requested basic or advanced indexing expression and return the selected values.
contracts.hardened_mode_behavior: Same as strict mode; reject malformed indexing metadata before execution.
